==About==

Crafting a {{i|Turtoadit}} will make an {{i|Uncooked Turtoadit}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Turtoadit. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
